Read-only review (Opus). Not built here.

Verdict: Ready to merge.

Blockers: none.

Checks:
1. Merge: `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main origin/issue/2720-tilted-gouge-audit` gives a clean tree. The PR adds two new files only.
2. STEP import change (#2904, #2918): no test of this PR loads a STEP fixture. All parts are synthetic meshes from `cube(..)` through `ImportModel::from_mesh`. The change to solidcore cannot change the readings of this PR.
3. Coverage of the kinds: `OpParams::tilt` in `crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs:1395` gives a tilt to 10 kinds: Face, Contour, Pocket, Adaptive2D, Offset2D, Engrave, Chamfer2D, Circular, Slot, Trace. The new binary has one test for each of nine kinds. Slot stays in `tilted_gouge.rs` (#2600). TrochoidalSlot, Probe, PlasmaProfile and WireContour answer `None` in the same match. The PR covers all the tilted kinds.
4. The tests cannot pass when the gouge check does not run. `convicted` returns `false` when no `Warning::Gouge` or `Warning::StockChamferGouge` is on the toolpath. `assert_refused_in` then fails with the missed pose. When the verdict is present, the test requires an `Err` from `posting::post_setup` with "post blocked". In a tilted pose, the error must also contain "cuts past the finish surface". The test also requires that no file is written. The assert of a non-empty move list stops a test that gives an empty cut.
5. The chamfer text: `Warning::StockChamferGouge` prints "move N cuts past the finish surface (stock-source chamfer ...)" (`crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs:380`). Thus the name assert holds for the 2D Chamfer too.
6. Upright 2D Adaptive is not in this binary. `keep_law.rs` `adaptive_aligned` covers it with the same 3 mm area offset. The gap is closed.
7. Placement: `crates/app/tests/` is correct. The file imports commands, `operation`, `posting` and `model` from `crates/app/src`. The module comment has a Gate map line and a provenance line.
8. Size and speed: the file has 293 lines. The author reads 52 s for the full binary (10 passed) in debug. No single test is near 60 s. No heavy-lane change is necessary.
9. No test is deleted or made weaker. No snapshot PNG. The decision file `docs/decisions/2720-tilted-gouge-audit.md` records the probes and the dropped options.
10. Body: it has what changed, a result table, the readings on head 678f3a37e (`tilted_gouge_kinds`, 10 passed), what was not exercised, `Changelog: none`, and `Fixes #2720`. The issue asks for the audit and a new issue for each gap. No gap was found, so `Fixes` is correct.

Notes (no change needed):
- The tilted name assert does not include the operation name ("K1: move"), as `keep_law.rs:149` does. One operation is in each world, so the result is the same.
- The upright guard asserts only "post blocked". This is correct, because the stock simulation also judges upright moves.
- `docs/decisions/2720-tilted-gouge-audit.md` line 30 is longer than the other lines. This is cosmetic.

This PR is flagged ready for the merge. Merge class: SAME (no commit after the reviewed head). The merge relies on the read-only review (Opus) with the marker for head `678f3a37ea88e06e23fafdc450d7e94a2f2c4fe9` and on the author's quick gate in the PR body. The PR adds one test file and one decision file, and its tests load no STEP file. Nothing is pushed after this flag.
